newsitem.title: USA: Corporate Express Q3 shr down with charge.
newsitem.headline: Corporate Express Q3 shr down with charge.

text.p: Corporate Express Inc said Wednesday that revenues for its third quarter, ended November 30, increased to $825.9 million from $435.3 million for the third quarter of fiscal 1995.

The company said net income was $17.9 million for the third quarter of fiscal 1996 compared to $10.6 million for the third quarter of fiscal 1995; earnings per share were $0.22 for the third quarter of fiscal 1996 compared to $0.15 for the third quarter of fiscal 1995.
The company said operating profit of $37.9 million for the third quarter increased from $20.9 million for the same quarter of the previous fiscal year.
The above results exclude $12.4 million in net merger and other non- recurring charges primarily related to the November acquisition of United TransNet Inc.
Including the merger charge, the company said earnings per share for the quarter were $0.09 vs $0.15 for the same period in 1995.
